sloka: ततः प्रभाते विमले कृतपौर्वाह्णिकक्रियः ।अभिचक्राम काकुत्स्थो दर्शनं पौरकार्यवित् ।। ७.६०.२ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ prabhāte vimale kṛtapaurvāhṇikakriyaḥ ।abhicakrāma kākutstho darśanaṁ paurakāryavit ।। 7.60.2 ॥

translations.english: Then, in the clear morning, Rama, having completed his morning rituals and being knowledgeable about the citizens' affairs, proceeded to the audience hall.
